incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: elevated 500s for /v1/embeddings (region: eu-west) starting 12:04 UTC. Error rate spike -> 48% failures. Routing fallback triggered to alternate variant.

alice-oncall: Ack. I'm taking this. Paging oncall SRE. Observed customer-facing 500s for a handful of orgs (finbot, insightai).

ben-sre: Quick grep of logs shows runtime errors: `RuntimeInterfaceMismatch: expected embeddings, got chat` across the embed workers after alias rotation. Looks like alias `embeds-prod` now points to a chat-capable model.

ben-sre: snippet from mapping service:```
alias: embeds-prod
-> model: redwood-chat-v2
region: eu-west-1
declared_interface: chat
expected_interface: embeddings
```

maria-engineering: Confirming: last night's rollout anchored `release-2026-03-16` updated several aliases. The deploy script had a mapping bug that defaulted variant to `chat` when model metadata was missing. It appears `embeds-prod` got overwritten.

dan-devex: Suggested mitigation: update alias back to a known embeddings-compatible variant and force routing to embed runtime. Command I ran locally (will push if OK):
```
redwoodctl alias set embeds-prod --model redwood-embed-v1 --variant embeddings --force
```
We should also block cross-variant fallbacks until we validate compatibility.

alice-oncall: Please apply that as emergency change. Ben, Maria — can you validate no schema mismatch remains?

infra-bot: change applied by dan-devex at 12:18 UTC: `embeds-prod` -> `redwood-embed-v1` (variant: embeddings). Rolling restarts of embed workers initiated.

ben-sre: Post-change telemetry: error rate dropped from 48% -> 6% within 4 minutes. Latency normalizing. Customer error counts for finbot: 55% of their requests failed during the window 12:04–12:18 UTC (~2200 failed calls).

emma-support: Noted impacted accounts (finbot, insightai, datawave). I'll loop in account reps and draft a short status note: "We've mitigated the issue; some requests may have failed between 12:04–12:18 UTC. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." Will post to affected customers after PM sign-off.

maria-engineering: Root cause summary for postmortem: alias-rotation script did not check `model.variant` field when promoting anchors; missing metadata caused default to `chat`. Immediate fix: validate metadata presence and add a compatibility check before alias mutation.

ben-sre: Action items:
- emergency rollback applied (done)
- add preflight validation on alias set (block if expected_interface != model.variant)
- add alert for `RuntimeInterfaceMismatch` with higher paging priority
- run a canary of alias rotation with synthetic embedding requests

claire-pm: Thanks. Please include timeline + affected orgs and SLA impact in the postmortem. I'll coordinate customer comms and prioritize a retro.

alice-oncall: Marking incident as mitigated at 12:22 UTC. We'll keep monitoring for 1 hour. Assigning owners: maria (root cause and fix), ben (alerts + canary), dan (deploy guard rails), emma (customer comms).

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> MITIGATED. Postmortem requested by @claire-pm.

alice-oncall: Quick note — we should add a unit test in the alias-rotation pipeline that asserts `declared_interface == expected_interface` to avoid silent defaults.

maria-engineering: Agreed. I'll open the PR today and tag for expedited review.

emma-support: Draft ready, sending to claire for review.

ben-sre: Will follow up with a short playbook entry for handling cross-interface fallback alerts.

alice-oncall: Great work team. Closing handoff — monitoring only. :white_check_mark:
